payload.text: I run a two-vet small-animal clinic in Galway. I want a booking system our receptionists use on the desktop machines at the front desk, plus a page where existing clients can book their own routine appointments. We only handle cats and dogs, no equine or farm work, and I do not want that added later either. Routine consultations are twenty minutes and vaccination boosters are ten minutes. Surgery slots are booked by staff only and never online. We are open 08:00 to 18:00 Monday to Friday and 09:00 to 13:00 on Saturday. The thing that actually matters to me is that clients stop missing their booster shots. At the moment a nurse rings around and it eats an entire afternoon every week. The system should remind them automatically and the reminders need to actually work. It also has to be safe with the animal records, because some of what is in there is sensitive. We have roughly four thousand active client records sitting in the desktop package we use today and they need to come across.

Two more things I forgot. Payments stay outside the system entirely. Clients pay at the desk on the card terminal we already have, so do not build anything that takes money. And clients can cancel online up to twenty-four hours before an appointment. After that they have to ring us. That is decided.
